newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK TO BOOST SHARE CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK TO BOOST SHARE CAPITAL.

text.p: Hoiupank, the second largest bank in Estonia, said on Tuesday that it will propose to its shareholders' meeting on April 12 to increase its shares with an issue aimed at its employees.
The management will propose that the board increase the bank's share capital by 37 million kroons, from 165 million kroons to 202 million kroons, over three years, the bank said in a statement.
Hoiupank employees can subscribe to 350,000 new shares.
The bank said that the price of the new shares will be no less than the bank's listed price as of December 31, 1997.
The bank also said that according to the business law the existing share holders will give up their priority rights for the 350,000 shares.
